newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek core inflation stuck at 8.2pct in Sept-bank.
newsitem.headline: Greek core inflation stuck at 8.2pct in Sept-bank.

text.p: Greece's core CPI-based inflation was flat at 8.2 percent year-on-year in September, unchanged from August, mirroring the behaviour of the headline inflation which was stable at 8.5 percent year-on-year in September, according to calculations were made by an economist at an Athens-based foreign bank.
Greece's National Statistics Service does not release core inflation figures which exclude volatile food and energy prices.
The official headline consumer price inflation was released last Friday. It stood at 8.5 percent year-on-year in September, unchanged from August.
